Kabus22 provenance: AMD FidelityFX SDK (FSR 3.1.4 upscaler subset)
=====================================================

Upstream
  Repository  https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK
  Tag         v1.1.4 (release notes: FSR 3.1.4; sdk/include/FidelityFX/host/ffx_fsr3upscaler.h VERSION 3.1.4)
  Commit      c6efa6bf7f2027b3ec94f28578bb5965eabb9e55
  Archive     https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK/archive/refs/tags/v1.1.4.tar.gz
              (GitHub tag archives are not guaranteed byte-stable; the per-file hashes below are authoritative)
  License     MIT, LICENSE.txt (installed as share/doc/kabus22/third_party/FidelityFX-SDK-LICENSE.txt)
  Ported from the sibling project IKV (third_party/FidelityFX-SDK, IKV-PROVENANCE.txt), same archive and patches.

Selection
  What FSR 3.1.4 upscaling needs on the Vulkan backend: the fsr3upscaler host component, the VK backend (ffx_vk.cpp),
  its GLSL passes and gpu headers (fsr3upscaler, fsr1, spd, core) and the shared host helpers. Paths are kept as in the
  upstream tree. Frame interpolation, optical flow, the Win32-only FrameInterpolationSwapchain, the fsr3 wrapper
  component, ffx-api, samples, prebuilt DLLs and other effects are not vendored.

Kabus22-owned files around it (not upstream)
  tools/k22_fsr3_blobs.py             replaces the Windows-only FidelityFX_SC: glslangValidator SPIR-V for the 10 FSR3
                                      upscaler passes x sharpening (LDR input, unjittered render-resolution motion,
                                      non-inverted depth) + SPIR-V descriptor reflection into <build>/k22_fsr3_blobs.h
  third_party/k22-ffx-posix/k22_ffx_posix.h  force-included POSIX stand-ins (_countof, wcscpy_s, strcpy_s, sprintf_s),
                                      FFX_SDK_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_SIZE 1 MiB (wchar_t is 4 bytes on Linux) and the engine's
                                      dlopen Vulkan dispatch (native/vulkan_loader.hpp, VK_NO_PROTOTYPES)
  native/fsr_vk.hpp, native/fsr_vk.cpp  wrapper: blob accessor, capability clamp, shared resources, upscale dispatch

Local patches (each marked "Kabus22 local patch (shared with IKV)" in the source; numbering follows IKV-PROVENANCE.txt,
IKV patch 6 touches frame interpolation only and is not vendored)
  1. sdk/src/backends/vk/ffx_vk.cpp, findMemoryTypeIndex: skip memory types with VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_COHERENT_BIT_AMD
     unless that property is requested (RADV lists its uncached device-coherent type last; VUID-vkAllocateMemory-
     deviceCoherentMemory-02790 and uncached memory for every FSR resource).
  2. sdk/src/backends/vk/ffx_vk.cpp, ffxGetScratchMemorySizeVK + CreateBackendContextVK: scratch sub-arrays aligned to
     alignof(BackendContext_VK::EffectContext) (alignas(32)) instead of 4 bytes, plus slack; GCC -O2 aligned SSE stores
     into pEffectContexts crashed with 4-byte offsets.
  3. sdk/src/components/fsr3upscaler/ffx_fsr3upscaler.cpp: a failed ffxFsr3UpscalerContextCreate released nothing
     (VUID-vkDestroyDevice-device-05137); context->device is set only after the backend context exists and a failed
     create calls the idempotent fsr3upscalerRelease.
  4. sdk/include/FidelityFX/gpu/fsr3upscaler/ffx_fsr3upscaler_callbacks_glsl.h: rw_luma_history storage format qualifier
     rgba8 -> rgba16f, the format of FSR3UPSCALER_LumaHistory1/2 (validation Undefined-Value-StorageImage-FormatMismatch).
  5. sdk/src/backends/vk/ffx_vk.cpp, CreateBackendContextVK: the global descriptor pool passed poolSizeCount = 5 of 6
     pool sizes, dropping VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER; now _countof(poolSizes).

+            // IKV local patch: never select AMD device-coherent/uncached types (RADV lists them last) unless requested;
+            // they require the deviceCoherentMemory feature and bypass the GPU caches.
+            if ((memProperties.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_COHERENT_BIT_AMD) && !(requestedProperties & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_COHERENT_BIT_AMD))
